key: A shifting draft winds through the peaks...
en: A shifting draft winds through the peaks...
ja: 移ろう風が　峰々を　吹き抜けていく……

key: A strong gust picked up!
en: A strong gust picked up!
ja: 強い突風が　吹き上げた!

key: TAKA: Ehh? It just got that much more windy?
en: TAKA: Ehh? It just got that much more windy?
ja: タカ: ええ? そんなに　急に　風が　強くなったんですか?

key: A breeze like this could blow you right off the mountain.
en: A breeze like this could blow you right off the mountain.
ja: こんな風なら　山から　吹き飛ばされても　おかしくないですね。

key: Or... across it, maybe?
en: Or... across it, maybe?
ja: それとも……　山を　越えて　どこかに　飛ばされるとか?

key: That feels like a stretch though.
en: That feels like a stretch though.
ja: さすがに　それは　言い過ぎな気も　しますけど。

key: TAKA: I feel like I can see half the world from here.
en: TAKA: I feel like I can see half the world from here.
ja: タカ: ここからだと　世界の半分が　見えるような　気がします。

key: Or maybe it's just bigger than my world's ever been.
en: Or maybe it's just bigger than my world's ever been.
ja: それとも　僕の知ってた世界が　単に　狭かっただけかも。

key: A single Egg has been left in the nest.
en: A single Egg has been left in the nest.
ja: 巣に　タマゴが　ひとつ　残されている。

key: Take it?
en: Take it?
ja: 持って行きますか?

key: \PN got the Egg!
en: \PN got the Egg!
ja: \PNは　タマゴを　手に入れた!

key: TAKA: There was an Egg here? Is it really okay to just take that?
en: TAKA: There was an Egg here? Is it really okay to just take that?
ja: タカ: ここに　タマゴが　あったんですか? 本当に　もらっちゃって　いいんでしょうか?

key: Then again, with gusts this strong, that Egg might very well have had a big fall and not been put back together again.
en: Then again, with gusts this strong, that Egg might very well have had a big fall and not been put back together again.
ja: まあ　これだけ　強い突風なら　そのタマゴも　いずれ　大きく落ちて　もう元には　戻らなかったかも　しれませんね。

key: And you know,
en: And you know,
ja: それに　あの……

key: Frankly, same.
en: Frankly, same.
ja: 正直　僕も　同じかもしれません。

key: ...Thanks for taking us in, \PN.
en: ...Thanks for taking us in, \PN.
ja: ……受け入れてくれて　ありがとうございます\PN。

key: TAKA: I'm not sure what's more unsafe:
en: TAKA: I'm not sure what's more unsafe:
ja: タカ: どっちが　より　危険なのか　わかりません――

key: Hopping across all this rock like it's a thing people do,
en: Hopping across all this rock like it's a thing people do,
ja: こんな岩を　当たり前みたいに　飛び渡ることなのか

key: Or the entire rest of my life.
en: Or the entire rest of my life.
ja: それとも　これからの僕の人生　全体なのか。

key: TAKA: Remember that time I said crossing the mountain using the wind was a stretch?
en: TAKA: Remember that time I said crossing the mountain using the wind was a stretch?
ja: タカ: 風を使って　山を越えるなんて　言い過ぎだって　言ったの　覚えてますか?

key: Consider me stretched.
en: Consider me stretched.
ja: 撤回します。

key: TAKA: Wow, despite being above the desert, it's almost chilly out here.
en: TAKA: Wow, despite being above the desert, it's almost chilly out here.
ja: タカ: わあ　砂漠の上だっていうのに　ここは　ほとんど　肌寒いですね。

key: Must be that breeze.
en: Must be that breeze.
ja: あの風の　せいでしょうね。

key: Um, some of these rocks look precarious...
en: Um, some of these rocks look precarious...
ja: あの　この岩　いくつか　不安定に　見えるんですが……

key: I'm not really good with heights, but I'll try to follow you as best I can.
en: I'm not really good with heights, but I'll try to follow you as best I can.
ja: 高いところは　あまり　得意じゃ　ないですけど　できる限り　ついていきます。

key: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
en: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
ja: この　いわの　なかで　エネルギーが　かがやいている……

key: Do you want to mine the rock?
en: Do you want to mine the rock?
ja: いわを　さいくつしますか？

key: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
en: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
ja: 頑丈すぎて　壊したり　動かしたり　できないようだ……

key: The rock base may hold more valuables.
en: The rock base may hold more valuables.
ja: この岩の土台には　まだ　お宝が　眠っているかもしれない。

key: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
en: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
ja: ばくはつのこなで　開けますか?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
